content:
**Gunsmith** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Ranged weapons break slower.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Guns break 50% slower. | 0039D06A | 
| ★★ | 2 | Guns break 35% slower. | 0039D069 | 
| ★ | 1 | Guns break 20% slower. | 0039D068 | 

- Although bows are usually not considered guns, the game checks for ranged weapons, which bows are.
- The perk card image shows a BB gun being repaired. However, it does not appear in-game as a usable weapon.
- Before update 60, the perk had 5 ranks that increased guns' durability by 10%/20%/30%/40%/50%. The perk also allowed crafting of certain guns; with higher ranks, more guns were available for crafting. As of this patch, the guns can be crafted without the need of any perks.

Other perks that increase durability include:

- Licensed Plumber - pipe weapons
- Makeshift Warrior - melee weapons
- Power Patcher - power armor
- Stable Tools - power tools
- White Knight - armor
